assign.outcome:
**Three answers, and a working blog at [/blog/](/blog/).**

**1. Meta tags: YES, the hybrid works.** A post ships a real `index.html` carrying the og:/twitter: tags as bytes, and its last line is the site's own `/app.js`, so the same url renders the real page. `curl /blog/how-this-blog-works/` returns 200 text/html with og:title / og:description / og:url / og:image / twitter:card in the raw bytes, no JS run. Headless at 400/1280/1920/3440: the post renders, both parts route, zero JS errors, zero 4xx. It boots from a nested path because `/app.js` is root-absolute, every module resolves against `import.meta`, and the router walks `location.pathname`. **No Server/ change needed** - `express.static` answers a trailing-slash directory request with its index.html, exactly as `/fly/` has since 2026-08-17; Cloudflare does the same. The trailing slash is load-bearing.

**2. Structure: a manifest plus a two-line page.js.** `posts.js` is the ONE copy of every title/date/description (the index would otherwise import five post modules to print a list). A post is a directory: `page.js` = `new Post({ meta: import.meta })`, prose in `.md` files, `index.html` stamped by `node public/blog/meta.mjs --write` (run by hand, output committed - not a build step). `parts: {stem: Title}` makes each part a real Page whose prose swaps while the head and rail stay.

**3. Reading page: stop centering, spend the right.** Measure hard left at 40em, exhibits float into everything left over, a 15em rail always holds the edge. **Ink to edge at 3440: 100px** (that is the page gutter) vs **2266px dead** on an ordinary prose page, vs 1360px each side for a centered column. read/exhibit/rail at 3440 = 720/2171/243.

![the post at 3440](post-3440-scrolled.png)

- Shots: [3440](post-3440.png) - [1920](post-1920.png) - [400](post-400.png) - [index](index-1920.png)

**Two silent traps found, both documented.** `[read-end] [exhibit-start]` - two adjacent line-name groups in `grid-template-columns` - is a parse error and the whole track list is dropped with nothing logged (the grid still rendered, track 1 at 0px). And a two-column grid puts a ~300px hole in the prose at every tall figure, which is why exhibits are floats.

**Left for the mastermind:** one line in `public/page.js` `sections` (and optionally `app.js` `nav`) - /blog/ is linked from nowhere on the homepage. `site` is hard-coded as lew42.com so branch previews get production og:urls. The index at 3440 has one card and lots of room; it fills as wave 2 adds posts.
